text:
Alyssa: Quick sync  we need a small ops plan for launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar CTA routing. Scope: sitemap entries, JSON-LD for article + event, redirects for 8 legacy slugs, and inbound lead tagging. Can content/SEO/dev triage? :calendar:
Miguel: Which URLs exactly? legacy microsites or just new launch pages?
Emma: New launch pages (launch post, benchmark longread, webinar landing, speakers pages, quickstart) + ~8 legacy slugs to redirect.
Sam: I can handle redirects; need canonical list. For Netlify we can use _redirects like:
```
/old-run/launch-2023  /launch/2026  301!
/blog/benchmark-old   /benchmark/2026 301
```
Will PR after list confirmed.
Miguel: Sitemap guidance: include canonical paginated-1 only, add rel=prev/next on subsequent pages. Priorities: launch blog=0.7, benchmark=0.6, webinar=0.8.
Emma: JSON-LD: Article for benchmark + Event for webinar. Quick webinar scaffold (fill in speakers/time):
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Launch & Benchmark Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-05-18T16:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar"},
  "organizer": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}
}
</script>
```
Also Article markup with mainEntityOfPage + author/meta.
Alyssa: Inbound lead routing: HubSpot form should set hidden fields utm_campaign=launch_may2026 and campaign_source=organic. Leads into HubSpot list "Launch_May2026"; Zapier -> SFDC queue "Marketing_Webinar" for MQLs. Miguel can you standardize UTM names?
Miguel: Standard: utm_source=organic|paid, utm_medium=cta|email, utm_campaign=launch_may2026. I'll add GH doc: marketing/utm-guides/launch-may-2026.md.
Sam: Dev note  pre-render OG tags and include structured data server-side for the webinar landing. Strip utm_* from canonical URLs.
SEO Bot: Reminder: add <link rel="canonical"> to paginated articles and mark noindex on tag archive pages that duplicate content.
Emma: Internal linking plan: benchmark -> features, quickstart, speakers, webinar CTA at top + mid-article. Use varied anchor text: "benchmark results", "how it performs", "register for demo".
Alyssa: Owners: Emma = content (deliver JSON-LD + canonical list) by EOD tomorrow; Miguel = UTM doc + sitemap priorities; Sam = redirects + SSR OG + canonical handling. I'll verify HubSpot flow with CS. React with :white_check_mark: to ack.
Miguel: \u2705
Emma: \u2705 compiling JSON-LD and canonical list now.
Sam: \u2705 prepping redirect PR  will @mention.
Alyssa: Thanks  I'll drop the QA checklist and schedule a 15m runway call the day before. :rocket:
